subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper bought 20 kg of apples for ₹3,600 and sold them at the rate of ₹220/kg. How much profit (in ₹) did he make?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

CP per kg = 3600 ÷ 20 = 180

SP per kg = 220

Profit per kg = 220 − 180 = 40

Total profit = 40 × 20 = 800

**∴ Answer = ₹800**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total cost price = 3600 for 20 kg

Selling price per kg = 220

**Formula used:**

Profit = SP − CP

**Calculation:**

⇒ CP per kg = 3600 ÷ 20 = 180

⇒ Total selling price = 220 × 20 = 4400

⇒ Profit = 4400 − 3600 = 800

**∴ The correct answer is ₹800.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Formula

Profit = Selling Price − Cost Price

Unitary Method

Find per unit cost, then multiply

Total SP

Total SP = rate × quantity

Key Insight

Always compare total SP and total CP

9d
